# 20 59 Ventures Corp. — Complete Business & Capabilities Profile

## Executive Summary
20 59 Ventures Corp. is an Alabama-based, CMS-registered Multi-Specialty Provider (NPI: 1932035060), VOSB (Veteran-Owned Small Business), and WOSB (Woman-Owned Small Business). The company delivers integrated Housing Placement, Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT), and Nutritional Meal Support across three active regional service hubs in Tuscaloosa, Dothan, and Montgomery, Alabama.

---

---

## Core Operations & Capabilities

### 1. Client Placement & Housing Navigation
- Direct referral platform linking veterans, seniors, HUD-VASH, and Medicaid waiver clients with verified housing units.
- Dedicated landlord liaison network accepting HUD and regional vouchers with rapid 48-hour turnarounds.

### 2. Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT)
- Specialized van transportation and transportation brokerage ensuring clients reliably reach healthcare and clinical appointments.

### 3. Nutritional & Home Meal Coordination
- Facilitating home-delivered meals and nutritional support pipelines to reinforce long-term independent living stability.

### 4. Human-Led AI Dispatch (Harry)
- Proprietary 24/7 AI-assisted coordinator routing intake referrals, transport requests, and status updates under direct human care team oversight.
